correctness.rationale: For square-zero A of rank r in dimension 2r, choose A=[0,I;0,0]. Anticommutation gives B=[P,Y;0,-P]; B²=0 iff P²=0 and PY=YP even in characteristic 2. Let t=rankP and H=kerP/imP of dimension h=r-2t; projection on B image proves rankB=2t+rank(Y on H)=2t+u. Square-zero P ranks counted by choosing imP,kerP and an isomorphism; its centralizer dimension is c=(r-t)^2+t². The induced centralizer-to-End(H) map is onto with kernel c-h², giving count Gaussian[r,t] Gaussian[r-t,t]|GL_t| q^(c-h²) Gaussian[h,u] product_{i<u}(q^h-q^i). Smooth rank-u endomorphism strata fibred over rank-t square-zero orbit have dimension r²-(h-u)², irreducibility; top u=h strata closures give floor(r/2)+1 components. Independently enumerated all r=2,q=2 (P,Y) combinations and recovered exact rank stratification 1,9,6,12 including all 28 B. Boundaries t=0 and h=0 valid; prime powers supported algebraically, finite tests only prime q.
